commits.body:

Ordinary target preparation consumes the staged deployment order and independently observes duplicate classes. Also checked twelve original multi-release calls across JDK 8, 17 and 21, the inherited caller on both revisions, equal-byte shadowing, two duplicate lib.jar URLs and the original-client 11/102/12 control. Native and stock staged sentinels passed, and the independent strict Log4j run reproduced the timezone boundary.

The prior Log4j comparison completed both original cold claims but compared encoded return objects to the archive's raw strings. All 32 frozen returns matched after normalization.
